sources.entry: Bartender - Organize or hide menu bar icons on your Mac.

summary.name: Bartender 7
summary.one_liner: Bartender 7 is a macOS menu bar manager for hiding, organising and automating menu bar icons, with keyboard-driven search and triggers.
use_cases: Hide clutter icons in the Mac menu bar
Keep menu bar tidy on a notched MacBook
Show battery or VPN icon only when needed
Search and trigger menu bar items from the keyboard
summary.what_it_does: Bartender 7 lets you hide, show and rearrange items in the Mac menu bar. Its Command Bar lets you search and trigger any menu bar item from the keyboard, and includes clipboard history. Triggers automate when items appear, such as battery when unplugged, a VPN on public Wi-Fi, or a mic during meetings. Items hidden by the notch can be moved to Bartender Bar or brought back with a click or hotkey. The page says it can run without Screen Recording permission, showing app icons instead of item images.
notable: Command Bar for keyboard search and triggering of menu bar items, plus clipboard history
Triggers and widgets that show items based on battery, network, or mic state
Automatically hides notch-obscured items and brings them back via Bartender Bar
Works without Screen Recording permission, using app icons instead
caveats: Paid product: one-time, yearly (with 14-day free trial) and lifetime options; the page's prices did not load in the text
Pro features such as Top Shelf are in the Pro suite, not the base Bartender 7 license
Without Screen Recording permission, menu bar items display as app icons rather than images
